notes.title: MoeNovel Titles on Sale & News!
notes.content:
Hi All! 

We have our MoeNovel titles on sale now in Steam's Weekly Sale! 

As well as, having our games on sale, we also have two very exciting pieces of news! 

[h1]New Wings: Akari[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/848ba4940bd61de7d6fcaef3f730f65810e8a781.png[/img]

We currently working on bringing Akari's route as DLC for If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary-! 
The route focuses on Akari, and her unique story and will be coming soon!


[h1]LoveKami -Healing Harem-[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33601479/31b8a8afaff2b9dcde2c80b61651f26d93867c08.jpg[/img]

We are excited to announce that LoveKami -Healing Harem- is now also available in Simplified Chinese! 

The third installment in the LoveKami series descends upon Steam! LoveKami -Healing Harem- is a visual novel set in the same universe as LoveKami -Divinity Stage- and LoveKami -Useless Goddess-. 
With a different setting to the previous two chapters, Healing Harem introduces us to the Tatarigami, known as Goddesses who spread misfortune. 
Set in a community deep within the mountains, Akira spends most of his time listening to the Goddess' troubles and helped them find solutions.

All fans that own If My Heart Had Wings will find a special, limited edition Chrismas Wallpaper for If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- in their local files [b]for the duration of the Winter Sale only![/b] The download period ends on January 3, 2019.

Make sure your copy of If My Heart Had Wings is up to date, and click:
Properties→Local Files→Browse Local Files→Special Wallpaper

We [u]highly recommend[/u] you copy these wallpapers to a save location on your computer as the wallpaper will automatically be removed from the If My Heart Had Wings folder on January 3, 2019


[h1]If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- Coming January 2019[/h1]

While If My Heart Had Wings -Flight Diary- is technically a fan disc for If My Heart Had Wings, it includes six stories - including the prologue and epilogue to the main story - and acts as a sort of sequel to the original.

This new game will be coming to Steam in January 2019. Stay up to date and get notified upon its release by adding it to your wishlist now!

[h1]The OSTs![/h1]
Both soundtracks are available in flac, mp3 and wav formats! 
A Sky Full of Stars Soundtrack features 32 tracks from the game, including Star Map and Winter Diamond!
Adventure of a Lifetime Soundtrack features 19 tracks from the game, including Step into the Ocean.

notes.title: Adventure of a Lifetime Out Now!
notes.content:
We are really excited to announce that Adventure of a Lifetime is out now on Steam! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32612059/fb958eb6df9791d3ae7cc73171a7889325744e05.png[/img]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/820730/Adventure_of_a_Lifetime

[i]“There’s something I need to get back.
Something precious that sank into the ocean years ago."[/i]

The story takes place on the World Heritage-listed Ogasawara Islands.

Emily, the beautiful blonde-haired girl.
Chisa, the childhood friend with golden, suntanned skin.

This summer, pass the days on a tropical island with two beautiful girls, scuba diving, and adventure!

Their destination: the “Ghost Ship”.
Somewhere just past where the sky meets the sea...
